claude_proposed_widenings.name: targeting_interception (OngoingOperation variant)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Sanctuary's ongoing operation intercepts targeting attempts by other creatures against the warded creature, then opens a save gate on the attacker. The two existing OngoingOperation variants — roll_modifier (adds a dice bonus to rolls made by the warded creature) and damage_on_hit (adds damage when the caster hits someone in scope) — do not express this shape. A third variant is needed: fires when any hostile creature designates the attachment as its target, requiring an attacker-side WIS save; on fail, the attacker loses the targeting attempt (block_targeting effect).
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: any creature who targets the warded creature with an attack roll or a damaging spell must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or either choose a new target or lose the attack or spell

claude_proposed_widenings.name: self_break_condition (Duration or SpellMechanicsHeader field)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The current Duration discriminated union (instantaneous | concentration | timed) has no way to express early termination triggered by the warded creature's own actions. The v4 lifecycle atom self_break exists but cannot be wired up: SpellMechanicsHeader has no field for it, and Duration.timed has no optional breakOn array. Sanctuary requires 'timed 1 minute + break when warded creature attacks, casts, or deals damage'.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The spell ends if the warded creature makes an attack roll, casts a spell, or deals damage.
